title: PO-based goods invoice
oneLine: Standard 3-way match goods invoice against an approved PO and GRN.
extraction: Line items: description, qty, UoM, unit price, line value
Subtotal, tax rate & amount per rate, total, currency
Bank details (capture only — never auto-update master)
checks: Vendor master: exists, active, not blocked, tax ID on invoice = master (else exception — fraud/wrong vendor)
Duplicate check (multi-layer): exact, normalised invoice no., fuzzy ±0.5% / ±7 days, cross-entity scan
Arithmetic: Σ lines = subtotal; subtotal + tax = total; qty × price = line value (rounding ≤ 0.05/line)
Tax validity (AU): "Tax Invoice" stated, ABN valid (live Lookup), GST 10% on taxable lines, buyer identity ≥ AUD 1,000
3-way match (line level): qty ≤ (PO open AND GRN unbilled); price within §9 tolerance; UoM conversion applied
PO status: approved, not closed/cancelled; invoice currency = PO currency (no silent conversion)
Date sanity: not future; > 12 months → controller approval; posting date per open-period rules
Freight/surcharges not on PO: allowed to tolerance as unplanned delivery cost; above → buyer approval
match: Price ±2% capped AUD 100/line → PPV or inventory
Qty over-billing 0% — never auto-accept qty > GRN (block, request credit/new GRN)
Qty under-billing allowed (partial invoice, consume PO progressively)
approval: Fully matched within tolerance → touchless auto-post (the PO approval was the approval)
accounting: At GRN: Dr Inventory / Expense  /  Cr GR/IR clearing
At invoice: Dr GR/IR clearing + Dr GST receivable  /  Cr Accounts Payable (vendor)
Price variance in tolerance: Dr/Cr Purchase Price Variance (or load to inventory)
Unplanned freight: Dr Freight-in / Inventory
special: Consignment stock → no AP at receipt (see DT-20)
Returns after invoicing → expect DT-04 credit note
Invoice for cancelled PO → auto reject-to-vendor with reason

title: Purchase order (copy)
oneLine: Supporting bundle member — PO PDF that anchors the 3-way match dossier.
checks: Reference role — supplies PO price/qty baseline for the 3-way match
accounting: N/A — supporting document
special: Strongest dossier linkage key — PO register / upload only

title: Goods receipt note (GRN) / delivery docket
oneLine: Supporting bundle member — GRN PDF that completes the 3-way match.
checks: Reference role — supplies received qty baseline; new GRN triggers event-driven re-match
accounting: At GRN: Dr Inventory / Expense  /  Cr GR/IR clearing

title: Credit note / adjustment note
oneLine: Negative-amount note that mirrors and reduces an original invoice — never auto-nets against unrelated invoices.
checks: Must reference original invoice; locate it. If not found → vendor-level open credit, flag AP supervisor
Credit reason classification: return, price correction, rebate, duplicate-invoice reversal, damaged goods
Goods returns: bundle return delivery note; qty credited ≤ qty returned
Credit note amount ≤ original invoice residual value (cannot over-credit)
Tax: GST credited at same rate as original
Duplicate-direction check: ensure not an invoice misclassified as a credit (sign errors)
match: Match to original invoice / return / price approval
approval: Touchless if matched to return/price approval; else AP supervisor
accounting: Dr AP  /  Cr GR/IR / Expense / Inventory / PPV (mirror of original)  /  Cr GST receivable (reduce input tax)
Apply against original for payment netting; if paid → open credit nets next run or refund-collection workflow
special: Orphan credit (original not found) → AP-supervisor open credit

title: Debit note (vendor- or buyer-issued)
oneLine: Buyer-issued (charges vendor) or vendor-issued (additional charge) — never posts touchlessly.
checks: Buyer-issued: requires claim approval evidence (shortages, quality claims)
Vendor-issued: treat with full invoice rigor — match to cause (price escalation, FX clause, demurrage)
Never auto-post vendor debit notes touchlessly; minimum AP-analyst review
accounting: Buyer-issued: Dr AP / Other receivable  /  Cr Inventory/Expense recovery  /  Cr GST adjustment
Vendor-issued: full invoice posting (increases payable)

title: Proforma invoice / advance (down-payment) request
oneLine: A proforma is NEVER posted as a payable/expense and NEVER creates an input tax credit (not a tax invoice).
extraction: PO with down-payment terms / signed contract
checks: HARD RULE: a proforma is never posted as a payable/expense and never creates an input tax credit (not a tax invoice)
Verify PO/contract permits advance; verify advance % and amount vs terms
Check bank guarantee requirement
System must block paying the final invoice gross when an open advance exists against the PO (auto-net rule)
match: Match to PO down-payment terms / contract
approval: Treasury + DOA approval for the payment (advances are higher fraud risk)
accounting: Payment posts: Dr Vendor advance (prepayment asset)  /  Cr Bank
When final tax invoice (DT-01/02) arrives: post normally then clear Dr AP  /  Cr Vendor advance
special: Ageing report on open advances > 60 days → chase final invoice
bundleMandatory: PO with down-payment terms, or signed contract

title: Recurring / contract invoice (rent, lease, subscription, retainer)
oneLine: Matched to the contract register; lease invoices post to lease liability under AASB 16, not rent expense.
checks: Match to contract register: amount = contracted ± escalation; period not already billed (vendor + contract + period unique)
Contract active and not expired
Escalation changes (CPI / fixed %) → validate calculation; route variance to contract owner once, then update expected
Lease under AASB 16 / IFRS 16: rent invoice does NOT post to rent expense
approval: First invoice of new contract + any post-escalation invoice → one-time contract-owner confirmation
accounting: Lease: Dr Lease liability + Dr/Cr per lease schedule  /  Cr AP (interest & ROU depreciation from lease subledger)
Variable lease components (outgoings, usage) → expense
Auto-accrue if expected recurring invoice not received by period close
bundleConditional: CPI / escalation calculation sheet on rate change

title: Utility invoice (power, water, gas, telecom)
oneLine: Matched to site/meter register with consumption analytics; > ±40% deviation flags facilities review.
checks: Match to site/meter register (account number → site → cost centre). Unknown account → facilities exception
Consumption analytics: usage vs same-month-last-year and trailing 12-month band; > ±40% → facilities review before payment
Estimated vs actual reads: flag estimates; reconcile on true-up invoice
Late-payment penalties → strip into separate GL (penalties), root-cause if our delay
approval: Disconnection notices route as priority (DT-22 informational + urgent flag)
accounting: Dr Utility expense (by site CC) + Dr GST  /  Cr AP
Accrue unbilled consumption at period end from meter data

title: Freight, logistics & customs broker invoice
oneLine: Matched to shipment; broker disbursements split duty/GST pass-through from taxable service fee.
extraction: Base freight, fuel surcharge %, terminal fees
checks: Match to shipment: AWB/BL/container must exist in logistics data; charges vs rate card
Detention/demurrage requires ops confirmation of cause and days
Broker disbursement: split duty/GST pass-through (no markup, match to customs entry) from broker service fee (taxable service)
Never allow GST on top of pass-through duty amounts incorrectly
accounting: Inbound freight on inventory → Dr Inventory / landed cost
Outbound freight → Dr Distribution expense
Duty pass-through → landed cost; import GST → Dr GST receivable (on customs entry; deferred GST scheme = no cash GST)
special: Broker disbursement split (pass-through vs service fee)

title: Import dossier (commercial invoice + customs entry + duty)
oneLine: Landed-cost dossier — mandatory and blocking bundle of commercial invoice, customs entry, transport doc, packing list.
checks: Bundle is mandatory and blocking: commercial invoice + customs entry + transport doc + packing list (+ origin cert for preferential duty)
Customs value vs commercial invoice (Incoterms-adjusted)
Duty rate vs tariff code; FX rate per customs vs accounting policy
Quantity reconciliation: packing list ↔ GRN ↔ invoice
match: Qty reconciliation packing list ↔ GRN ↔ invoice
approval: Blocking bundle — cannot post until all mandatory members present
accounting: Goods Dr Inventory at PO/commercial value
Duty + non-recoverable charges capitalised via landed-cost allocation (value/weight/qty)
Import GST recoverable Dr GST receivable; FX differences → FX gain/loss or inventory per policy
special: Under/over-shipment → claims workflow + insurance dossier if damaged

title: Intercompany invoice
oneLine: Symmetry rule — both entities book the same period, amount and FX reference rate; mirror entry validated.
checks: Counterparty must be a registered IC partner; IC agreement and transfer-pricing basis on file; markup % per TP policy
Symmetry rule: both entities book same period, same amount, same FX reference rate
System creates/validates the mirror entry (AP one side, AR other); feeds IC reconciliation
Out-of-balance at close blocks consolidation sign-off
Tax: cross-border IC → WHT, GST/VAT reverse charge as applicable
approval: Per IC policy (often controller-level, not operational DOA)
accounting: Dr IC expense / asset  /  Cr IC payable (partner-coded)

title: Employee expense claim / reimbursement
oneLine: Per-line policy & receipt checks with fraud analytics; FBT-flagged lines tagged for the FBT register.
checks: Per-line: receipt attached (tax invoice over threshold), policy limits by category, date within claim window (e.g. 90 days)
No weekend/leave-day anomalies unless travel-approved; mileage vs distance table; per-diem vs actuals (never both)
Fraud analytics: duplicate receipt image hash, sequential receipt numbers, round-number clustering, split claims under thresholds
Corporate-card lines reconcile to card feed (no cash reimbursement of card spend)
FBT flagging (AU): entertainment, employee benefits lines tagged for FBT register
approval: Line manager + policy-exception approver where breached
accounting: Dr Expense by category/CC + Dr GST (only where valid tax invoice held)  /  Cr Employee payable / Cr Bank (card)
bundleMandatory: Itemised receipts per line (tax invoices over threshold)

title: Vendor statement of account
oneLine: NEVER posted as an invoice — auto-reconciled vs the AP subledger to detect missing invoices and duplicates.
checks: NEVER posted as an invoice (second most common duplicate-payment cause)
Auto-reconcile statement lines vs AP subledger
Items on statement not in AP → request copy invoice (missing-invoice detection — key completeness control)
Items in AP not on statement → possible duplicate or mis-posting; balance differences → ageing dispute workflow
accounting: No journal — reconciliation output only
special: Monthly statement-reconciliation exception report for top-20 spend vendors (mandatory control)

title: Contract / rate card / SOW / lease agreement
oneLine: Supporting bundle member — the contract register entry that validates recurring & services rates.
checks: Reference role — supplies contracted amounts, rate cards and escalation basis
accounting: N/A — supporting document
special: Lease agreements feed the AASB 16 lease subledger

title: Service entry sheet / timesheet / completion certificate
oneLine: Supporting bundle member — the service-receipt evidence for DT-02 services matching.
checks: Reference role — the receipt document for services; stored in dossier
accounting: N/A — supporting document
special: Where no SES exists, requester confirmation becomes the receipt document

title: Remittance advice (inbound or outbound copy)
oneLine: Supporting document — confirms which invoices a payment settles; not posted itself.
checks: Reference role — links payment to settled invoices
accounting: N/A — supporting document
special: Outbound copy generated automatically at payment

title: Self-billed invoice / RCTI (Recipient-Created Tax Invoice)
oneLine: We generate the invoice from receipt/consumption data; a vendor invoice for an RCTI vendor is blocked as duplicate-risk.
checks: Valid RCTI agreement must exist (dated, current)
We generate the invoice from receipt/consumption data
Vendor must not also send an invoice — vendor invoice for RCTI-flagged vendor/PO → BLOCK as duplicate-risk, route to AP supervisor
approval: RCTI agreement governs; duplicate vendor invoice → AP supervisor
accounting: Accounting as DT-01; we also issue the tax document and report GST accordingly
special: Vendor-sent invoice for RCTI vendor blocked as duplicate-risk

title: Consignment / ERS (Evaluated Receipt Settlement) settlement
oneLine: Consignment receipt creates no liability; ERS GRN auto-generates the invoice — vendor invoices are blocked.
checks: Consignment: receipt creates no liability; consumption/withdrawal triggers self-billed settlement
ERS: GRN auto-generates the invoice at PO price — price master accuracy is the control
Vendor invoices for ERS POs are blocked (duplicate prevention) and returned referencing the ERS agreement
match: GRN → auto-generated ERS invoice at PO price
approval: Governed by agreement; vendor invoice blocked
accounting: Consignment: Dr Inventory→COGS / Expense  /  Cr AP at agreement price
special: Price master accuracy is the ERS control

title: One-time vendor invoice / refund request
oneLine: Highest fraud-risk class — independent call-back bank verification, sanctions screen and collusion check mandatory.
checks: HIGHEST fraud-risk class
Mandatory: independent bank-detail verification (call-back to a number sourced independently, NOT from the invoice)
Tax-ID validation, sanctions / denied-party screening
Duplicate-person check vs employee bank accounts (collusion control)
Cap: one-time vendor payments above threshold (e.g. AUD 10k) prohibited — force full vendor onboarding
Customer refunds via AP: match to credit balance in AR before payment
approval: Payment blocked until call-back verification completes
accounting: Standard invoice posting only after verification — payment blocked until verified

title: Dunning / payment reminder letter
oneLine: Informational only — links to the referenced invoice's status; disconnection notices flagged urgent.
checks: Informational — never posted
Link to the referenced invoice's current status in the system
Disconnection notices route as priority (urgent flag)
accounting: No journal
special: Surfaces a payment that may already be in flight

title: Bank / vendor detail change request
oneLine: Critical fraud control — never update bank details from an email/letter alone; independent call-back + 4-eyes required.
checks: NEVER update vendor bank details from an emailed invoice or letter alone, even on genuine letterhead
Workflow: independent call-back verification to known contact + second-person approval in vendor master + penny-test (micro-deposit) + 100% audit log
Any in-flight payments to that vendor are held until verification completes
Invoices arriving with bank details ≠ master → pay to master details, flag mismatch; do not silently adopt invoice details
approval: Vendor master team (4-eyes) — payments held until verified
accounting: No journal — master-data control
special: Returned payment + "new bank details" email = classic fraud pattern

title: Quote / order acknowledgement / sales brochure / spam
oneLine: Non-actionable — auto-archived with 30-day recoverability; never hard-deleted, never posted as a payable.
checks: Must NEVER be classified as a payable tax invoice (highest-frequency real-world posting error)
Auto-archive with 30-day recoverability; never hard-delete
accounting: No journal
special: "Proforma / Quotation / This is not a tax invoice" wording prevents payable classification

title: Tax authority documents (assessments, GST notices)
oneLine: Compliance class — routed to the Tax team, not the AP posting flow.
checks: Routed to Tax team
Not processed as a payable invoice
accounting: Posted by Tax team per assessment, outside AP flow
special: GST assessments, ATO notices → Tax team workflow

title: Customer tax invoice (outbound AR)
oneLine: Outbound customer tax invoice — tenant is seller; routes to Sales Management for AR and revenue posting.
extraction: Invoice number, invoice date, due date
Line items: description, qty, unit price, line value
Subtotal, tax rate & amount, total, currency
checks: Customer identity on document
Duplicate check on invoice number + customer
Arithmetic: lines, subtotal, tax, total
Tax validity: tax invoice wording, GST rate on taxable lines
Date sanity: not future; due date present for receivables tracking
No PO reference required (outbound sales)
match: Optional reference to sales order or quote — not required in v1
approval: Clean match to sales GL rule → auto-code
accounting: Dr Accounts Receivable  /  Cr Revenue
Dr Accounts Receivable  /  Cr GST payable (output tax) where applicable
special: Tenant must appear as seller on document
Credit notes against customer → separate adjustment workflow

title: Sales order (copy)
oneLine: Supporting bundle member — sales order PDF that anchors the outbound 3-way match dossier.
checks: Reference role — supplies SO price/qty baseline for the 3-way match

title: Delivery note / dispatch docket (outbound)
oneLine: Outbound delivery note or dispatch docket linked to a sales order.
checks: Links to sales order for fulfilment match
match: DN qty vs SO and customer invoice
